Title: Suresh and the Family

Cast

1. Suresh - 35 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Anil - 65 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
3. Pallavi - 59 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The village well - Day

[Suresh stands by the well. Anil stands near him.]

Anil: "Today feels like a good day."

[Suresh draws water from the well with the rope.]

Suresh: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Suresh drinks water from his cupped hands.]

Suresh: "This is amazing!"

[Suresh splashes water on his face at the well.]

Suresh: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Suresh stands in the living room. Anil stands near him.]

Suresh: "So, here we are!"

[Suresh sips red wine.]

Suresh: "That's easy."

[Suresh drinks a beer.]

Suresh: "What next?"

[Suresh wraps a bandage around his bleeding hand.]

Suresh: "What happened?"

[Suresh waves at his sister on a video call.]

Anil (surprised): "Good job, Suresh!"

[Suresh jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Suresh: "That's great!"

[Suresh throws a bucket of water on the fire.]

Suresh: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Suresh dies in the fire.]

Anil: "We will never forget you."
